WITH fee_order_join AS (
  SELECT 
    f.feesnode,
    f.orderslink,
    f.feerate,
    f.rebrate,
    o.dealedge
  FROM fees f
  INNER JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault
  WHERE f.feerate > 0.0009
),
group_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    orderslink,
    dealedge,
    AVG(feerate - rebrate) AS group_avg_net_fee_rate,
    COUNT(*) AS record_count
  FROM fee_order_join
  GROUP BY orderslink, dealedge
),
side_avgs AS (
  SELECT 
    dealedge,
    AVG(group_avg_net_fee_rate) AS side_avg_net_fee_rate
  FROM group_stats
  GROUP BY dealedge
)
SELECT 
  gs.orderslink,
  gs.dealedge,
  gs.group_avg_net_fee_rate,
  gs.record_count,
  (gs.group_avg_net_fee_rate - sa.side_avg_net_fee_rate) AS diff
FROM group_stats gs
JOIN side_avgs sa ON gs.dealedge = sa.dealedge
WHERE gs.group_avg_net_fee_rate > sa.side_avg_net_fee_rate
ORDER BY diff DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10
